name: editable
pattern: Inline editing with native buttons and an input / textarea
responsibility: Switches between viewing and editing and manages commit, cancel, native validation, and focus return. The user renders preview text and owns persistence

targets.preview: One HTMLElement containing the displayed content and the edit button
targets.editor: One HTMLElement containing the input and save / cancel buttons; do not nest it with preview
targets.input: One native input type=text or textarea inside editor
targets.edit: One named button type=button inside preview
targets.save: One named button type=button inside editor
targets.cancel: One named button type=button inside editor

authorMarkup.labels: Name the input with a visible text label, aria-label, or aria-labelledby. Name buttons with text or explicit ARIA. The subset of text-name rules is the same as toggle-group. The user supplies label meaning, units, and descriptions
authorMarkup.initial: Use input.value as the initial committed value. The user renders preview content corresponding to that value. Markup may set the editor's initial hidden state, but connection synchronizes it to viewing
authorMarkup.content: The controller does not generate preview numbers, text, or elements. Persistence and preview updates are performed by the commit event consumer or user JavaScript

semanticElements: Place exactly one of each target and make all targets descendants of the root. preview and editor are separate, non-containing HTMLElements. input / save / cancel are inside editor and edit is inside preview
input is input type=text or textarea. Every operation button is type=button, and no element serves two target roles
When a field or button has no name, do not supplement it; disable enhancement
completion: When edit aria-controls is absent, set editor.id and issue one completion warning while connected. Preserve an authored value
contractValidation.completionExempt: Write editor.id, edit aria-expanded, preview / editor hidden, and root data-state without warnings because they are required for behavior and state. Do not write role or aria-live
contractValidation.invalidMarkup: For an invalid configuration, cancel the editing draft, restore initial hidden / aria-expanded, and remove root state. Do not move focus. Warn once while connected. When valid again, connect in viewing with the current input.value as the committed value

value.description: In viewing, native input.value; in editing, the committed value at edit start. The setter updates committed value and draft without dispatching an event and keeps editing when active. The getter is an empty string and the setter is a no-op when invalid or disconnected

edit().description: Start editing and focus the input. Return false when already editing, when input is disabled / readonly, or when markup is invalid. Do not dispatch an event

commit().description: When native checkValidity succeeds, commit the draft and return to viewing. Return false when not editing, input is disabled / readonly, or the value is invalid. Do not dispatch an event

cancel().description: Restore the draft to the value committed at edit start and return to viewing. Return false when not editing. Do not dispatch an event

editable:beforeedit.detail: EditableChangeDetail: { value: string, previousValue: string, reason: "pointer" | "keyboard" }. preventDefault stops the state change

editable:edit.detail: The same EditableChangeDetail. Notify after state commitment and any required focus movement

editable:beforecommit.detail: EditableChangeDetail: { value: string, previousValue: string, reason: "pointer" | "keyboard" }. preventDefault stops the state change

editable:commit.detail: The same EditableChangeDetail. Notify after state commitment and any required focus movement

editable:beforecancel.detail: EditableChangeDetail: { value: string, previousValue: string, reason: "pointer" | "keyboard" }. preventDefault stops the state change

editable:cancel.detail: The same EditableChangeDetail. Notify after state commitment and any required focus movement

behavior.value: While editing, native input.value is the draft. Commit and cancel update input.value, but the user updates preview content. commit previousValue is the earlier committed value, cancel previousValue is the discarded draft, and edit has equal value and previousValue
behavior.activation: Trusted clicks on edit / save / cancel and input key operations dispatch the corresponding before / after events. Ignore synthetic or already-handled events and disabled buttons. Methods and the value setter do not notify
behavior.blur: Do not commit or cancel on blur. Preserve the draft even after the user operates an outside element
behavior.validation: Validate user saves with native reportValidity and remain editing when invalid. API commit uses checkValidity. When a viewing input receives a trusted invalid event, show the editor without notification or direct focus movement so native validation can reach the input
behavior.focus: Focus the input when editing starts without selecting all. After commit or cancel, return focus to the edit button only when focus is inside editor or on body. Do not return it when focus moved outside. Respect focus and state changes made by before listeners
behavior.reentrancy: Do not commit an old request when a before listener changes API, draft, settings, targets, or connection. Do not dispatch an old after event when a focus listener changes state
behavior.disabled: Read native :disabled and input.readOnly and prevent editing and saving. Cancel remains possible regardless of input disabled / readonly. Keyboard save and cancel also respect the corresponding button's disabled state
behavior.reset: Capture document reset and compare its input.form at dispatch time. When the associated form's native reset is not canceled, synchronize to viewing after returning to defaultValue. Do not dispatch an event or move focus
behavior.dynamic: Validate target replacement within the same microtask against the final configuration. When a target changes, discard the old draft and begin viewing from the new input.value. Inspect label / type / disabled / readonly / form changes with a root observer and immediately before operations

keyboard.Tab: Move to input, save, and cancel in native order. Do not create a focus trap
keyboard.Enter: On a single-line input, save and prevent implicit form submission. A normal Enter in textarea inserts a newline. Enter on a button performs native click
keyboard.Escape: Cancel from the input. Ignore during IME and with modifiers
keyboard.Control+Enter / Meta+Enter: Save in textarea. Alt / Shift combinations and simultaneous Control+Meta are outside the scope
keyboard.IME: Do not process keys with isComposing or keyCode 229

managedMarkup.root: data-state=viewing|editing. Do not write class, layout style, role, or aria-live
managedMarkup.editor: hidden only while viewing. When assigning an id, avoid collisions with authored ids in the document
managedMarkup.edit: Synchronize aria-expanded with state. Supplement aria-controls when absent
managedMarkup.preservation: Preserve input name / value / constraint validation / form owner, authored ARIA / id / labels, and preview content. Update input.value as behavior for commit, cancel, and the value setter
managedMarkup.cleanup: On disconnect, target replacement, or invalidation, discard the draft and restore hidden / aria-expanded changed by the controller to their pre-connection values. Retain supplemented id / aria-controls

consumerIntegration.saving: Persist the commit event value and update the preview. To wait for asynchronous persistence, cancel beforecommit and call API commit after success. The API emits no event, so the consumer handles the result
consumerIntegration.form: Preserve the native input name and form association. On form submission, field.value is the draft while editing and the committed value while viewing. The consumer controls submit when the draft should not be submitted
consumerIntegration.nested: When receiving an event from a nested instance outside, narrow it with :self or event.target === event.currentTarget

lifecycle: Subscribe to root click / keydown, settings observer, input invalid, and captured document reset in connect, and remove all subscriptions in disconnect
On reconnection of the same instance, begin viewing from the current field.value and do not duplicate listeners
Do not move focus from the controller during passive target / form / validation synchronization

observations.item: Announcements when editing starts at the input and focus returns to the edit button
observations.impact: The public specification is based on native input/button semantics and DOM focus and does not depend on announcement wording

acceptanceCriteria: Require WCAG 2.2 Level AA. The user owns field/button names, validation explanations, and preview updates and appearance
AAA 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception): no pointer-only feature; everything is operable with native buttons and keys
AAA 3.2.5 Change on Request: move focus only for user operations and explicit API calls, never timer or passive synchronization
Verify commit/cancel, native validation/form reset, before cancellation, IME, disabled state, reentrancy, dynamic targets, and cleanup in all three engines
Verify both field configurations and every state / event / keyboard behavior in the catalog
Retain real-device screen-reader checks in the completion report when unverified

testMatrix.description: Synchronize initial value, hidden, ARIA, and root state while preserving preview content
Edit and commit through trusted operations and report before/after state and values
Cancel the draft with Escape and remain editing on blur
API and value setter do not notify or steal focus moved outside
Canceling every before event stops state changes and after notifications
Do not save an invalid draft and recheck custom validity from before listeners
Reveal native validation for a hidden input in editing and do not submit the form on Enter
Native form reset respects cancellation and returns to defaultValue without notification or focus movement
Respect disabled and readonly, while editing cancel does not depend on input state
Synthetic click and keydown do not change state
Do not process IME Enter or Escape
Keep textarea Enter as a newline and save with Control/Meta
Do not overwrite API, draft, target, or connection changes from before listeners
Do not emit after for editing canceled by a focus listener
Disable invalid names or target structure and return to viewing after repair
Same-microtask target replacement discards the old draft and starts from the new input value
Assign a collision-free editor id and preserve authored id and aria-controls
Disconnect while retaining DOM, clean up draft/attributes/listeners, and reconnect
Capture reset for the current form owner
Preserve focus changes made by beforeedit listeners
